title: Adversarial Testing in LLMs: Insights into Decision-Making Vulnerabilities

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM behavior using game-theoretic paradigms (the two-armed bandit task and Multi-Round Trust Task) against a trained Reinforcement Learning adversary to measure computational bias toward exploitation, strategic rigidity, and susceptibility to choice manipulation.

Using psychology-inspired interactive experiments to assess exploration-exploitation trade-offs, risk-seeking vs. risk-averse tendencies, and behavioral adaptability to dynamic reward and fairness cues.
